finalMessage:
I implemented SHOP-57 (`R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT`) and left it uncommitted on `main`, with no branch or pull request. I had no Jira access, so I worked from the item text in `trace.yaml`. The tests pass (38 before I added tests to the volume group). `ostf check --base main` now shows 40 items, 115 valid, with no errors or warnings.

**What changed**
- **`src/pricing.ts`:** new `volumeDiscount(lines)` gives 5% off each line of 10 or more units, rounded down to the cent per line. `price()` takes an optional `volume` argument and applies the volume discount first, then the code discount on what is left. Together they are capped at 50% of the subtotal. Without the argument it behaves as before.
- **`src/checkout.ts`:** `placeOrder` passes `volumeDiscount(lines)` into `price`.
- **`src/pricing.test.ts`:** two tests, one for the threshold and rounding and one for ordering and the cap.
- **Trace links:** I linked the code and tests with `@req R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT` comments and did not edit the item.

**Needs your confirmation:** the item doesn't say how the code discount and the cap combine with the volume discount. I read it as the code percentage applying to the post-volume amount, with the combined discount capped at 50% of the original subtotal. Please check that against the Jira issue.

**Impact (per `ostf check`)**
- **Items:** `R-CHECKOUT-ORDER`, `R-CHECKOUT-SESSION`, `R-TAX-RATE` and `R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT`.
- **Tests to run:**
  - `checkout.test.ts#Checkout > places an order`
  - `checkout.test.ts#Checkout > needs a valid session`
  - `pricing.test.ts#price > taxes the subtotal after discounts`
  - `pricing.test.ts#tax > rounds half up to the cent`
  - `pricing.test.ts#volumeDiscount` and its two child tests
- **Links added:**
  - `src/pricing.ts#price` implements `R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT`.
  - `src/pricing.ts#volumeDiscount` implements `R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT`.
  - The two `volumeDiscount` tests verify `R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT`.

I rechecked the suspect and unstamped links against the code, ran the tests, and stamped them with `ostf stamp`. I didn't edit `trace.lock` by hand. No existing item became false.
